'''Telesom''' is a private telecommunication company established in 2002 by local entrepreneurs in [[Hargeisa]], Somaliland. It is the leading provider of ICT services in the country and offers a wide range of products including voice and mobile broadband, fixed broadband, SMS, mobile money, mobile education, mobile infotainment, and cloud offerings such as [[Software as a service|SaaS]], [[Infrastructure as a service|IaaS]], and [[Platform as a service|PaaS]] services.

Telesom was the first to introduce 2G, 3G, and LTE services to the country, and played a significant role in rebuilding the country after the war by building a robust telecommunication infrastructure and enabling access to digital payments via its flagship mobile money platform ZAAD SERVICE 
.

The company operates in the entire Somaliland, where it has the largest operation, and the company has affiliations with the biggest telecommunication companies in the neighboring countries and shares regional and international roaming service with them.<ref>{{cite web |title=Key Players in Somaliland's Telecommunication Sector |url=http://www.somalilandbiz.com/sector-guides/telecoms-2/#4_Key_Players_in_Somalilands_Telcom_sector |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210207072942/http://www.somalilandbiz.com/sector-guides/telecoms-2/#4_Key_Players_in_Somalilands_Telcom_sector |archive-date=7 February 2021 |access-date=28 January 2020}}</ref>

==History==
Founded in 2002 by local [[stakeholder (corporate)|stakeholder]]s, it became the first telecommunications company to operate in [[Somaliland]].<ref>{{cite web |title=About Telesom Company |url=https://www.telesom.com/about |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200127231003/https://www.telesom.com/about |archive-date=27 January 2020 |access-date=28 January 2020}}</ref>

==Dara Salam Bank==
The Dara-Salaam Bank was created in 2010, before its inception the bank was known as Salaam Financial Services.<ref>{{cite web |title=About Us |url=http://darasalaambank.com/index.php/about-us] |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190314175014/http://darasalaambank.com/index.php/about-us |archive-date=2019-03-14 |access-date=7 October 2016 |website=Dara Salaam Bank}}</ref>
